audit.whatIsWrong: Leona is female but tldr, loading and report[10].t call her "his".
audit.why: The owner is addressed as you; every third-person pronoun refers to Leona and must be her/she.
audit.corrected: Swap the three instances to her/she.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[0..6].side are all the unfilled "Skill" placeholder, and the level 2 through first-item why text (index 1-5) describe Renata's own kit even though content win[1..5] all say Leona wins those rows.
audit.why: packet.levelChart (Renata,Leona,Leona,Leona,Leona,Leona,Renata) matches content win[] exactly; Leona's E-Q chain-stun and later Solar Flare dictate the whole mid-game until Renata's items and R catch up late.
audit.corrected: Side to Renata on rows 0 and 6, Leona on rows 1-5; rewrite the level 2 through first-item whys around Leona's chain-stun and Solar Flare instead of Renata's own kit.

audit.why: diffRating 5.5/10 tracks the near-50% winrate (50.95%, 1152 games) with a heavy Leona-favored mid-lane window bracketed by even level-1 and Renata-favored late-lane rows — an even overall matchup that swings hard mid-fight.
